made_here: The pocket watch, microphones and stand, the two signs, the card house, the clippings book and the broadcast screen are modelled in art/v2/nesne/build.py; their pictures (dial, cards, signs, notebook page, cloth, grille) are drawn in art/v2/nesne/textures.py. The picture on the screen is rendered from this repo's own press room, prime minister and parrot (art/v2/nesne/live_picture.py). The second set (hatch cover, gold parachute, fin, giant bucket and chain, the fountain's water, old pump, stone trough, sandbag, treasury jug, sprouts, lunch pail, factory wheel, lectern, water-line plaque, ivy wall, net inlay) is modelled and drawn in the same two scripts. The forest and cold fire props (forest_props.py): the forked stick (bark from bark_brown_02), the wet burlap sack with its weave drawn here, the cast-iron guide and brass pull stake, the hurricane lantern, and the gold brick wall piece (colour and metal drawn here from the brick and mortar layout of red_brick_03, whose normal map it uses).
